reel.insight_note: Coaching institutes lose significant sales time on free strategy calls with leads who cannot afford their programs, making automated pre-qualification essential for growth.
reel.caption:
Coaching institutes are wasting dozens of hours on unproductive discovery calls with unqualified prospects.

Here is how to automate your intake:
1. Set up an automated chat on WhatsApp or website.
2. Ask 3 qualifying questions about budget, timeline, and goals.
3. Automatically route qualified leads to your calendar link.

Tip for today: Add a simple budget dropdown to your intake form right now to filter out low-intent leads before booking.

Save this post for later and send it to a business owner who needs to reclaim their schedule!

DM "AUTOMATE" for a free 15-min call.
